checks.name: Production application opens the initial local fixture
Chromium and preload security boundaries are enabled
Renderer bridge refuses unauthorized links and asset capabilities
Core Markdown, GFM tables, tasks and notes render
Source views preserve the original and dialect profiles change interpretation
Source and code Copy buttons use the native bridge without broad clipboard permission
Mathematics and both diagram engines render locally
Callouts and local SVG, PNG and wiki-image embeds render
Hostile HTML remains inert and executable attributes are stripped
Outline targets exist and duplicate headings have unique IDs
Find highlights matches and a theme change preserves readable content
Standalone HTML exports through the actual UI
Exported HTML reopens independently with images and diagrams
PDF exports through the actual UI and contains valid pages

details.note: Binary structure check; separate PDF text extraction and rendered-page review cover visual fidelity.

checks.name: Wiki links open their local Markdown target
Native Open command loads another local document
Changes to an opened local file reload automatically
A native file input crosses the dropped-file preload bridge
Unsupported runtime content stays inert and invalid diagrams do not stop reading
Desktop and narrow layouts remain usable without page overflow
Welcome and dark reading screenshots are captured
No uncaught renderer exceptions occurred

details.note: Missing-image and malformed-diagram fixtures may intentionally produce console diagnostics.

checks.name: Source and split edit the same text; preview, caret, undo and redo survive rendering
Ctrl+S writes real Markdown, preserves CRLF and resets dirty state
Cancel Open, discard prompt and Save As preserve the active draft
Failed save keeps edits and prevents a Save-and-open transition
Save As creates a UTF-8 document and later Save updates only that copy
External changes during an Open dialog reload after Cancel
External changes reload clean documents but cannot replace unsaved edits
Conflict Save a copy preserves the external version
Save then Open persists edits; Discard opens without writing them
New, Welcome, recent files, dropped files and local links honor Cancel
Pasted Markdown is unsaved and can be saved to a real file
Immediate HTML export includes the latest unsaved edit
Editor layouts work at desktop and minimum window width
Close Cancel retains the window and draft
Close Save persists the draft before the application exits
Technical defaults, keyboard cancellation and dialog layout
technical exports through the dialog without changing Markdown
studio exports through the dialog without changing Markdown
editorial exports through the dialog without changing Markdown
Export choices persist after reloading the app
Latest unsaved edit exports in light typography from dark reading mode
Canceling native save preserves the draft
Long grids, long code and oversized cards remain printable
Large export HTML bypasses data URL limits and blocks scripts
Export UI writes HTML and readable text through the native bridge
Conversion notes and paste guidance are visible in Document details
Immediate export includes unsaved edits and leaves the source file unchanged
Native File menu invokes the same Teams export
Oversize export does not truncate or replace clipboard contents
Native IPC rejects malformed and oversized payloads
Clipboard errors remain visible and the export can be retried
Menu remains accessible at minimum size and in dark mode

teamsDesktopPaste.boundary: One Windows desktop composer, unsent synthetic draft. Web/mobile and sent messages not tested.

limits: Installer built, not installed into the normal user profile
Automated clipboard writes and file-dialog responses substituted; actual clipboard and Teams draft checked separately
